svg.title: From evidence to action
svg.desc: Unconfigured prompt goes from question to a fluent answer. ConvictionDesk goes from a new market event to qualified evidence, thesis relevance, material change, an action direction, and what would change the decision. Insufficient evidence becomes UNDETERMINED, never a default HOLD.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
